steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: Explain, ambassador. Why did your Great Seer bring the Apostle of Ashes into DisCity?
The crowd splits into two factions, confronting each other. Among them, the Great Seer lying on the ground makes a timely wail, dragging traces of Mania contamination on the earth.
Her voice carries a chilling echo, not belonging to any language, but more like a monster's growl.
The Eastian sealer immediately turns away, face full of pity.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: She was the former seer with powerful psychic skills, capable of communicating with Wraith Spirits and all things. She recreated the Almighty Bow and was the greatest contributor in the Sun Shot battle seven years ago.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: But this right here... She is no longer herself.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Seven years ago, she invaded the Sun Crow's consciousness through channeling and suppressed the monster until others shot it and completed the sealing. But the Great Seer herself was also consumed by the Sun Crow after overexerting her power.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: She left the Ode to Sun as her last words... to remind us that her spirit would always be with us, always fighting against the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Should the seal be broken and the Sun Crow returned, by heeding her advice, crafting the Almighty Bow, and having the most steadfast believer shoot at the sun, we could rouse the Great Seer's last sliver of power to complete the sealing again.
But the Great Seer before you clearly cannot fulfill this grand promise, for she seems to have lost all sense of self.
Du Ruo's expression is cold. She's focused on the sorcery at hand, seemingly lost in thought.
But some of the people here still refuse to sympathize with this tragic tale.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: The Great Seer of Eastia, she's a self-awakened Sinner, right?

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: You mean to say that a mere Sinner could suppress the Apostle of Ashes without the shackles?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: It's true. The Great Seer indeed had such power, and she did it!

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: What are you doubting? We've committed no crime. You have no right to interrogate us.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: We may not have your Hypercubes, but Sunsink City, no... the East too has collectively stood firm under the calamity for a century. We rely on our own sorcery and have endured great sacrifices.
Schorl hovers quietly. After a long while, the flat synthetic voice speaks.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You said before that until the Almighty Bow was made, the envoys would subdue the Sun Crow with Eastian sealing sorcery to delay its assault on the DisSea.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Sealing sorcery... Sorcery... Mania manipulation...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We have seen the Underground use similar forbidden technology as well.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's a dangerous theory that exists beyond science, in which specific Mania-infected humans manipulate Mania and the power of contamination. Our enemies use it to spread contamination and expand the Black Rings, constantly seeking to subvert this city.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...What are you implying?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You claim it's a sorcery to weaken the Sun Crow, but is there any proof? Can you prove that your sorcery isn't meant to strengthen the Sun Crow and destroy our city?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Nonsense! We have no connections with your enemies! Are you trying to extort Eastia's sorcery and steal our core technology with this pretext?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: According to the border law, DisCity has no right to do this!

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: When the safety of the city is threatened, we have every right to take action.
You make to step forward, but one of your colleagues from the 9th Agency holds you back by the shoulder.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Operative
steps.content: This is all normal, Chief. The conflict is inherent, otherwise, the envoys wouldn't have so many secrets.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Operative
steps.content: DisCity is the only source of Hypercubes, and there are constant attempts to infiltrate and replace us. The spies targeted by the 9th Agency have already filled the archives. The tragic incidents they have led to in the past were way more intense.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Operative
steps.content: You're an honest person, Chief, but honesty does not exist between two cities, especially after BR-002, with new mines and resources entering the game. In places you can't see, all major Outland forces lurking in the city have long been itching to move.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Operative
steps.content: If you truly believe in Eastia, now is their chance to prove their innocence.
Yanyan has been protected by you since the Sun Shot. She's clearly startled by this sudden situation, instinctively clutching your sleeve and speaking with a trembling voice.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: No, we really don't mean any harm. The failure of the Sun Shot wasn't intentional... It's Yanyan's fault. Yanyan didn't explain the myth clearly, and I'm not powerful enough to complete the Sun Shot.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Let me try again. I'll make sure to do it right this time.
Yanyan's eyes are red, to which the DisCity officials only respond with annoyance.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: Why is this child still here? Stop using her as a decoy. We've seen through your intentions long ago.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: The Sun Crow is a monster released by Eastia. You can't take on DisCity yourselves, so you fused the Apostle of Ashes into the Sinner to break through the FAC's Apostle monitoring network. You let this monster into the DisSea to cause disasters and wreck our city.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: All those foolish superstitious rituals are just smoke screens to distract us!
He raises his hand, and the guards all aim their guns at the delegation.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...We endured a long harsh journey to come here expecting the distrust, but not a despicable trap like this. Haha...

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: It's only natural for DisCity to doubt our good intentions... Knowing what you've done in the past, you must not be able to believe we would repay you with kindness.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Calm down, ambassador. Focus on maintaining the sorcery. Now is not the time to be distracted. Don't waste your energy on reasoning with them.
But her words have little effect. The heat, the Mania, and years of suppressed doubt and anger have overpowered the ambassador's rational thinking.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: The center of the world, the frontline against Mania, haha... Now that we're here, we finally understand what you are.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: In N.F. 106, BR-003 broke out, and the drought of the ten suns almost burned down Sunset Town. We exhausted our resources and sacrificed many lives to suppress the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: In N.F. 112, BR-004 broke out. On the same day, Eastia was hit by catastrophic natural disasters. Haha, that's right, that's the Sinking of Eastia you guys like to joke about.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: We'd barely rebuilt Sunsink City when you brought the riots upon yourselves and triggered BR-002. That's why the Sun Crow suddenly broke its seal and went out of control.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: No wonder you always cover up the news about the Black Rings. Under the Perishing Star, every Black Ring is connected to the source of Mania, and each one could affect the whole world. It's all your fault.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Eastia sent the Sun Crow Apostle to invade DisCity? You are the ones forcing the whole world to suffer the consequences of your own deeds! And yet you're trying to smear us?!

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: And you dare probe for intelligence behind our back... This is blatant espionage. Arrest them!

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: You have all the time to explain yourselves in the interrogation room. You won't be leaving DisCity ever again!

The Eastian envoy is furious with indignation. The patterned light of the sorcery beside him flickers and shatters, and the temperature rises again. But besides you, the only person who notices this is...
That monster.

options: Stop it! The Sun Crow is still here...

steps.content: You want to stop the infighting, but the situation escalates quickly. The Apostle, previously groveling and suppressed by the sorcery and the Hypercube field, seizes the opportunity to strike back.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Mmph...!

Yanyan clutches her head and falls to the ground. Just like a few days ago, the consciousness of the Sun Crow Apostle contaminates the girl's mind again. You and she are impacted almost at the same time.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: The M-value is skyrocketing! A high-intensity Mania entity is activating!

It instantly sheds its weak and pitiful human disguise, inflating and spreading its massive wings of black flames. This time, it completely breaks through everything binding it, soaring and screeching. Contamination falls upon the entire battlefield like boiling rain.
And the only people left unscathed are...
A mass of dark flames envelops the Eastians, turning into broken wings that ward off the descending Mania contamination.
Strangely, this pitiful, barely human figure seems more like the person who invaded your dreams than the woman the Sun Crow just transformed into.

Even though protected by the black flames, Du Ruo's incense burner still cracks slowly, and the sorcerous formation has been broken. She opens her eyes slightly to see the blazing dark flames and the fierce fiery bird beside her.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Even though you've become like this, it's still in your instincts to protect your kin?
The Eastian sealers look at the atrocious Mania flames, then at the crumbling sorcery. Their faces turn pale.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: I let my anger get the better of me... Because of me, the sorcery...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It can't be helped. You've journeyed far and have been staying up for nights to maintain the sorcery. Your mind has reached its limits and couldn't resist that kind of provocation.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...What's done is done. There's no need to blame yourself. Let's just say it was meant to be.

The dazed DisCity representative's expression is a mixture of emotions, looking both terrified and smugly satisfied that his suspicions were confirmed. Despite the impending danger, his gaze remains firmly on the envoys.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: ...That monster is protecting them.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: See, they are in league with that thing. How dare you try to destroy DisCity with the Apostle of Ashes?!

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: Your sorcery won't last long. Surrender immediately!
The scholar looks around at the guards encircling her, then at the haughty DisCity representative, and toward Schorl. Looking surprisingly serene, she smiles.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Let's not waste time on mind games when a disaster is about to end us. I'll explain in terms you DisCity gentlemen can understand.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Apostles of Ashes are products of concentrated Mania, a material projection of collective consciousness. They manifest themselves in this world, in the forms of disasters and Wraith Beasts.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Hypercubes don't exist in Eastia. Facing the Apostle, people could only rely on their faith in the Sun Shot legend. In other words, they were fighting the product of collective will with their collective will.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: When the Great Seer crafted the Almighty Bow, she was activating this immense spiritual power. No matter how many times she failed, she always had that faith. This, Yanyan is surely capable of.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Our problem is not that the Sun Shooter is not powerful enough, but that...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: A single droplet makes no ocean. A sole tree forms no forest. Here and now, in this foreign land, no one shares our belief.
Suddenly, the giant bird cries out in the sky, breaking through all defenses and heading straight for the DisSea.
